angle: Design stable success, partial-success and failure contracts before connecting the tool to a larger workflow.

problem: manual file-by-file work does not scale
angle: Turn a repetitive file-by-file task into an observable batch with per-item outcomes and safe retry rules.

problem: an agent cannot judge vague tool descriptions
angle: Describe inputs, limits and failure modes so an agent can select and call the tool safely.
Map the complete lifecycle of inputs, derived files, logs and download links before approving a hosted processor.
Choose measurable quality boundaries instead of treating the smallest output as the best result.

problem: library and hosted-service trade-offs are hidden
angle: Compare local libraries, hosted APIs and managed actors using control, maintenance, isolation and observability rather than feature checklists.

problem: URL ingestion expands the network attack surface
angle: Treat remote document fetching as its own security component with redirect, address, byte and content policies.

problem: document jobs fail without useful evidence
angle: Instrument document automation around job identity, duration, byte counts, outcome codes and retention-safe logs.

problem: page ranges behave differently across tools
angle: Test page numbering, inclusive ranges, duplicates and invalid pages before migrating an existing workflow.

problem: general PDF tools are mistaken for redaction or signature systems
angle: Recognise when OCR, signatures, forms, redaction or archival requirements need a specialist workflow.
